preconditions.description: The lengths n and m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a)
preconditions.description: Array a has length n and contains integers within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == m and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in b) and all(b[i] < b[i+1] for i in range(m-1))
preconditions.description: Array b has length m, contains valid integers, and is strictly sorted in ascending order.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the count modulo 998244353.
The output equals the number of ways to partition array a into m consecutive subarrays such that the minimum of the i-th subarray equals b[i], modulo 998244353.
